tooltips.available: Whether the link opens the file right now: it is active, not expired and its usage limit is not reached.
tooltips.link: Public link to the file. Anyone who has the link opens the file without signing in.
tooltips.used: How many times the link was opened. Every request counts, also viewing the file in a browser.
tooltips.limitUsage: Limit how many times the link can be opened.
tooltips.allowedUsage: How many times the link can be opened. When "Used" reaches this number, the link returns "Forbidden".
tooltips.expires: Make the link work only till a specified date and time.
tooltips.validTill: After this date and time the link returns "Forbidden".
